senses.en: a person who makes money by starting or running businesses, esp. when this involves taking financial risks
examples: He would not have succeeded in such a risky business if he had not been such a clever [[entrepreneur]].

senses.zh: 意见（或判断）错误的，弄错的
senses.en: wrong in one's opinion or judgment
examples: She wondered whether she'd been [[mistaken]] about his intentions.

senses.zh: 错误地；曲解地；被误解地
senses.en: wrongly or by mistake
examples: This app will help you get a photo or document back if you [[mistakenly]] delete it.

senses.zh: 虫洞（宇宙中可能存在的连接遥远空间的通道）

senses.en: if buildings sprawl, they spread out over a wide area in an untidy and unattractive way
examples: The town [[sprawls]] along the side of the lake.

senses.zh: （懒洋洋地或漫不经心地）摊开手脚躺（坐）着
senses.en: lie or sit with your arms or legs stretched out in a lazy or careless way
examples: He was [[sprawling]] on the sofa watching his favorite TV program.

senses.en: walk slowly across or around an area, usu. without a clear direction or purpose
examples: She was [[wandering]] aimlessly up and down the road.

senses.zh: （尤指集市上的）货摊，摊位，售货亭
senses.en: a table or small shop with an open front that people sell things from, esp. at a market
examples: The street is lined with [[stalls]] selling Chinese New Year decorations.

senses.en: (pl. spectra) a complete range of opinions, people, situations, etc., going from one extreme to its opposite
examples: A balanced diet should contain a broad [[spectrum]] of plant and animal foods.

senses.en: an electrical wire or wires with a protective covering, usu. for connecting electrical equipment to the supply of electricity
examples: We used so many lights that we needed four extension [[cords]].

senses.en: a piece of thick string or thin rope
examples: Have you got some [[cord]] that I can tie this parcel up with?

senses.en: put all the parts of sth. together
examples: The shelves are sold in kits that you have to [[assemble]] yourself.

senses.en: if you assemble a large number of people or things, or if they assemble, they are gathered together in one place, often for a particular purpose
examples: Since she took over the department, she has [[assembled]] a talented team with a varied selection of skills.

senses.en: (literary) among or surrounded by things
examples: We camped in a shallow valley [[amid]] low hills covered with green pine trees.

senses.zh: 在（嘈杂、纷乱的事件）中（用于书面语或新闻报道中）
senses.en: while noisy, busy, or confused events are happening — used in writing or news reports
examples: The dollar has fallen in value [[amid]] rumors of weakness in the US economy.

senses.en: shine brightly with flashing points of light
examples: Smoothed flat by generations of wind and rain, the stone [[glitters]] in the sun.

senses.en: (usu. before noun) giving off many small flashes of light
examples: The day ended with a cruise on the Huangpu River where we saw the [[glittering]] skyline of Shanghai.

senses.zh: 抵制者（或组织）；不合作者（或组织）
senses.en: a person or organization who resists sth. or refuses to accept an offer
examples: A few [[holdouts]] still use typewriters, but nearly everybody uses computers now.

senses.en: make a copy of; imitate
examples: Entrepreneurs have to move faster than ever to ensure others don't [[clone]] their ideas.

senses.en: make an exact copy of a plant or animal by taking a cell from it and developing it artificially
examples: A team from the UK were the first to successfully [[clone]] an animal.

senses.en: the introduction of new ideas or methods
examples: We must encourage [[innovation]] if the company is to remain competitive.

senses.en: a new idea, method, or invention
examples: She believed she had come up with one of the greatest [[innovations]] of modern times.

senses.en: exist at the same time or in the same place
examples: Different traditions [[coexist]] successfully in this country.

senses.zh: 不断增加地；越来越多地
senses.en: more and more all the time
examples: [[Increasingly]], businesses are having to reduce their costs in order to survive.

senses.en: completely ready to do sth. or for sth. to happen, when it is likely to happen soon
examples: The company is [[poised]] to launch its new advertising campaign.

senses.en: not moving, but ready to move or do sth. at any moment
examples: Tina was tense, her hand [[poised]] over the telephone.

senses.en: not real or not made of natural things but made to be like sth. that is real or natural
examples: Energy is being wasted by using [[artificial]] lighting when daylight is adequate.

senses.en: (abbr. AI) the study of how to make computers do intelligent things that people can do, such as think and make decisions
examples: Language is crucial to the development of [[artificial intelligence]].

senses.zh: 发出持续的嗡嗡声；嗡嗡作响
senses.en: make a continuous low dull sound
examples: Above him an invisible plane [[droned]] through the night sky.

senses.zh: 意外的幸运事；不可思议的事；奇迹
senses.en: sth. very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible
examples: The economic [[miracle]] of this country has always been a mystery.

senses.en: sth. that encourages a process or activity to develop more quickly
examples: The grant for building the opera house gave [[impetus]] to the city's cultural life.

senses.zh: （变得）不能识别的，认不出来的
senses.en: (BrE also unrecognisable) sb. / sth. that is unrecognizable has changed or been damaged so much that you do not recognize them
examples: I hadn't been to the city for 20 years and it was almost [[unrecognizable]].

senses.en: be very important or a powerful influence at a particular time
examples: Silence [[reigned]] while we waited for news anxiously.

senses.en: rule a nation or group of nations as their king, queen, or emperor
examples: Queen Victoria [[reigned]] over Britain from 1837 to 1901.

senses.zh: （权力、重要性或影响力）最高的，至高无上的
senses.en: having the highest position of power, importance, or influence
examples: Winning an Olympic gold medal was, I suppose, the [[supreme]] moment of my life.

senses.zh: （尤指商业、贸易等领域的）部门，行业
senses.en: a part of an area of activity, esp. of business, trade, etc.
examples: Data is continuously transforming the current landscape of many industries, including the financial [[sector]].

senses.en: a small sign of sth. such as hope or understanding
examples: Despite an occasional [[glimmer]] of hope, this campaign has not produced any results.

senses.en: succeed in doing sth., esp. after trying very hard
examples: If we all work together, I think we can [[accomplish]] our goal.

senses.en: sth. that is an impressive achievement, because it needs a lot of skill, strength, etc. to do
examples: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge is a remarkable [[feat]] of engineering.

senses.en: completely change the appearance, form, or character of sb. / sth., esp. in a way that improves it
examples: The place was [[transformed]] from a quiet farming village into a busy port.

senses.en: undergo a change in appearance, form, or character
examples: The trip to the cinema [[transforms]] into a full-day activity for the family.

senses.en: the ability to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful
examples: They are anxious to maintain the [[momentum]] of the search for a solution.

senses.en: following one after another in a series without interruption
examples: After six [[consecutive]] defeats, the team was almost ready to give up.

senses.zh: （地域、系统、活动等的）中心，枢纽
senses.en: the central and most important part of an area, system, activity, etc., which all the other parts are connected to
examples: The city acts as the [[hub]] of the nation's railroads and highways.

senses.en: suddenly or surprisingly quickly
examples: He's realistic enough to know he's not going to succeed [[overnight]].

senses.en: for or during the night
examples: The temperature could fall below zero [[overnight]] in late autumn.

senses.en: in a way that people admire or respect
examples: The team played [[impressively]] throughout the game.

senses.en: (fml.) grow or develop quickly
examples: The company hoped to profit from the [[burgeoning]] market in artificial intelligence.

senses.en: an important new discovery in sth. you are studying, esp. one made after trying for a long time
examples: Chinese scientists have made a major [[breakthrough]] in chip manufacturing.

senses.zh: 航空航天工业；宇航工业
senses.en: the industry that designs and builds aircraft and space vehicles
examples: Many companies are conducting ground-breaking research for the future of the [[aerospace]] industry.

senses.zh: 巨大的；重大的；深远的；深切的
senses.en: very great; felt or experienced very strongly
examples: Over time, habits and routines have a [[profound]] effect on our quality of life.

senses.en: develop and change gradually over a long period of time
examples: Computer software will continue to [[evolve]] in response to users' needs.

senses.en: (of plants, animals, etc.) change gradually over a long period of time
examples: More complex animals gradually [[evolved]] from these very simple creatures.

senses.zh: 想象，展望（尤指美好的事）
senses.en: imagine sth. that you think might happen in the future, esp. sth. that you think will be good
examples: As a young teacher, I [[envisioned]] a future of educational excellence.

senses.zh: 共同意见；一致看法；共识
senses.en: an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with or accepts
examples: Could we reach a [[consensus]] on this matter? Let's take a vote.

senses.en: competing directly with another person or group
examples: Rather than go [[head-to-head]] with their main rivals, they decided to try a more subtle approach.

senses.en: (only before noun) in which two people or groups face each other directly in order to decide the result of a disagreement or competition
examples: He beat some of the world's greatest tennis players in [[head-to-head]] competition.

senses.en: a position on a scale that shows how good sb. / sth. is when compared with others
examples: Last year the tennis player rose from 39 to 35 in the world [[rankings]].

senses.zh: （行业的）全体从业人员；（公司的）全体员工；（国家或地区的）劳动力
senses.en: all the people who work in a particular industry or company, or are available to work in a particular country or area
examples: Senior executives are looking to build a highly skilled [[workforce]].

senses.zh: 顽强的；不屈不挠的；坚持不懈的
senses.en: (usu. before noun) showing determination; not giving up easily
examples: Her ambition and [[dogged]] determination ensured that she rose to the top of her profession.

senses.en: completely full of
examples: This website is packed with expert advice on how to manage time.

senses.en: at the present moment; for the time being
examples: [[For now]], our plan will remain unchanged until something convinces us otherwise.

senses.en: if sb. / sth. reigns supreme, they are the most important part of a situation or time
examples: At that time, the bicycle [[reigned supreme]] as Britain's most popular mode of transportation.

english: in the long / short / medium term

senses.zh: 长期 / 短期 / 中期
senses.en: used to say what will happen or what happens generally over a long, short, or medium period of time
examples: In the long term, alcohol causes high blood pressure.

senses.en: (esp. spoken) used to say that you are not surprised by sth.
examples: Under such circumstances, it is little wonder that they experience difficulties.

senses.zh: 硅谷（位于美国加利福尼亚州，因计算机和电子工业闻名）

senses.en: (GII)
(WIPO)
(gross domestic product)
